body.name: Constant convex-hull witness
body.construction: Under \(P_{\mathrm{const},\xi}\), let \(X\) be uniform, set \(P(A=1\mid X)=1/2+a\xi\), and draw independent binary potential outcomes with common mean \(1/2+b\xi\), independently of \(A\) conditional on \(X\). Let \(Q_{\mathrm{const}}\) have observed-data marginal \((P_{\mathrm{const},-}+P_{\mathrm{const},+})/2\) and a causal realization with its induced constant arm means.
